sql: select o.status, o.quantity, count(*) n, count(f.kalshi_order_id) with_fill, min(o.created_at) first_at, max(o.created_at) last_at from live_orders o left join (select distinct kalshi_order_id from fills) f on f.kalshi_order_id=o.kalshi_order_id where o.strategy='Hmmsell10' and o.action='buy' group by 1,2 order by 1,2
